name: @bybrawe/opencode-loop
reason: User-authorized installer contract patch from main. Publish Loop 0.6.6 with the recommended OpenCode 2 setup as two independent commands: install/update Loop with npx -y @bybrawe/opencode-loop@latest and install/update the dedicated Goal plugin separately with npx -y @bybrawe/opencode-goal@latest. A normal Loop install must not install, detect, refresh, migrate, or modify Goal; Loop's legacy /loop-goal* commands are omitted by default and remain explicit compatibility opt-in only. Preserve Goal 1.3.47 coexistence gates and the aligned v0.6.6 release artifacts.
